title: docs(adr): ADR-0069 — package-first authoring (Airtable base model)
body:
**Status: Proposed** — drafted from a business-user Studio dogfood pass; opening for team decision.

## What
ADR for the **Airtable-style package-first model**: every runtime-authored metadata item must live in a **writable package (base)**; no orphans. Code/installed packages are read-only; the **package is the delete / export / duplicate unit** (the answer to *"a pile of loose metadata — how do I delete it?"*).

## Why now
A dogfood pass surfaced a family of defects with one root cause — no package-first contract:
- **#2252** (read-only after publish): code-package context stamped new objects read-only → stopgap coerces to `package_id = null`.
- **#1946** (orphan pile): the null bucket has no delete container and is filtered out of package-scoped lists.
- **../cloud `service-ai-studio`** can still silently default into a catch-all `com.workspace`.

The ADR unifies the contract across **kernel** (`saveMetaItem`), **Studio UI**, and **../cloud AI authoring**, and retires #2252 / #1946 as transitional.

## Decisions
- **D1** no orphan authored metadata (writable `package_id` required; kernel rejects with `writable_package_required`)
- **D2** two package kinds — code/installed = read-only, writable bases = the only authoring target
- **D3** create-flow contract enforced on all three surfaces (pick/create a base first; no silent default)
- **D4** package = lifecycle unit (delete-cascade / export / snapshot / duplicate)
- **D5** retire the #2252/#1946 stopgaps via a migration affordance
- **D6** single-tenant framing; reject "org/local default" (it reproduces the orphan pile)

Tracking epic + rollout: see the package-first card.
